description: Fix all non-responsive patterns across Provider pages, Admin pages, and shared components. This feature is independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 in terms of file scope (only touches provider/*, admin/*, and components/), but should be committed after FEAT-001 since pages render inside layouts. Covers: 6 provider pages, 9 admin pages, ApplicationStatusTracker component.

=== SHARED COMPONENT ===
ApplicationStatusTracker.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\components\ApplicationStatusTracker.tsx):

The component already handles mobile with `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4` and has a vertical progress line for mobile. Review: the steps wrapper uses `relative grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-4`. The mobile vertical line `md:hidden absolute left-5 top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-gray-200` requires `pl-8` or similar on mobile step items to not overlap the line. Currently steps have `flex md:flex-col items-start md:items-center gap-3 md:gap-2`. The circle is `size-10` (40px = left-5 plus width 0.5 = ~45px offset). The flex layout starts the icon then content — the line at `left-5` is behind the icon. This is the existing intended design. No change needed.
=== ImageWithFallback.tsx ===

The component passes through className from the parent — the parent always provides `w-full h-auto` or similar. The error div uses `inline-block` which could be block-level issue in some containers. Change error fallback to `<div className={\`block ${className ?? ''}\`}>`. No major responsive issue.
Run `npm run build` inside e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd to verify no TypeScript errors.
